description: Source code for generating and manipulating JFFS2 on-disk structures for MTD flash memory, including functions for creating directories, files, parsing data, and writing JFFS2 images.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the buffer to align with the specified size, erasing blocks as needed.

methods.name: add_dirent
methods.description: Adds a directory entry with specified name, type, and parent inode.

methods.name: add_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory inode with specified name and parent.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a file to the filesystem structure, reading its contents and creating corresponding inodes.

methods.name: mtd_replace_jffs2
methods.description: Replaces part of the MTD with a JFFS2 filesystem image from a file.

methods.name: mtd_parse_jffs2data
methods.description: Parses JFFS2 data buffer to identify directory and inode information.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Writes a file into a JFFS2 filesystem on the specified MTD device.
